scope: Standalone Flutter panel for one-to-five-minute stock updates
behavior: The user independently chooses one- or five-minute bars and a one-through-five-minute refresh cadence
Start performs an immediate lookup; stop releases the controller; manual refresh is available only while safe
Price, actual observation time, volume, selected provider, dataset and attribution remain visible
Fallback attempts, stale/throttled state, next attempt time and bounded-backoff status remain visible
Panel disposal stops and disposes the refresh controller
Intraday data is explicitly informational and never posts or rewrites Ledger facts

notVerified: The standalone panel is not connected to production investment navigation
No real Fugle account, API key, device or live network was used
Secure credential storage and revocation UI are not implemented
gate: Standalone intraday UI passed deterministic widget checks; credential and final integration gates remain
